english: New Clock widget. Analog or digital, with seven face designs each — Classic, Minimal, Roman, Railway, Bauhaus, Neon and Skeleton for analog; Plain, Segment, Monospace, Flip, Outline, Stacked and Dots for digital — plus 12 or 24-hour time, optional seconds, and your choice of day, date and year underneath. Tapping it shows your next alarm, and you can pick which clock app that opens.
translation: Νέο γραφικό στοιχείο ρολογιού. Αναλογικό ή ψηφιακό, με επτά σχέδια προσώπων το καθένα — Classic, Minimal, Roman, Railway, Bauhaus, Neon και Skeleton για αναλογικό. Απλό, Segment, Monospace, Flip, Outline, Stacked και Dots για ψηφιακό — συν 12 ή 24ωρη ώρα, προαιρετικά δευτερόλεπτα και την επιλογή ημέρας, ημερομηνίας και έτους από κάτω. Πατώντας το δείχνει το επόμενο ξυπνητήρι σας και μπορείτε να επιλέξετε ποια εφαρμογή ρολογιού θα ανοίξει.

english: Home Assistant's own pages open inside HKI 7, full screen. A new Home Assistant section in Settings takes you straight to your server's Settings, Developer tools and HACS, already signed in, without leaving the app.
translation: Οι σελίδες του Home Assistant ανοίγουν μέσα στο HKI 7, σε πλήρη οθόνη. Μια νέα ενότητα Home Assistant στις Ρυθμίσεις σάς μεταφέρει κατευθείαν στις Ρυθμίσεις, στα Εργαλεία προγραμματιστών και στο HACS του διακομιστή σας, που είναι ήδη συνδεδεμένοι, χωρίς να βγείτε από την εφαρμογή.

english: HKI 7 now tells you when a new version is released. It watches the GitHub releases once a day and notifies you, which matters most if you installed the APK yourself rather than from Play — Update now sends you to Play or to the release page depending on where this copy came from. It can be turned off in Settings › About.
translation: Το HKI 7 σας ενημερώνει τώρα πότε θα κυκλοφορήσει μια νέα έκδοση. Παρακολουθεί τις εκδόσεις του GitHub μία φορά την ημέρα και σας ειδοποιεί, κάτι που έχει μεγαλύτερη σημασία αν εγκαταστήσατε μόνοι σας το APK και όχι από το Play — Η ενημέρωση τώρα σας στέλνει στο Play ή στη σελίδα έκδοσης, ανάλογα με την προέλευση αυτού του αντιγράφου. Μπορεί να απενεργοποιηθεί στις Ρυθμίσεις › Πληροφορίες.

english: A Next Alarm sensor joins the ones the app already reports to Home Assistant, matching the official companion app. Android only exposes the next alarm rather than the whole list, so that is what the sensor carries, along with which app set it.
translation: Ένας αισθητήρας Επόμενου συναγερμού ενώνεται με αυτούς που αναφέρει ήδη η εφαρμογή στο Home Assistant, που ταιριάζει με την επίσημη συνοδευτική εφαρμογή. Το Android εκθέτει μόνο τον επόμενο συναγερμό και όχι ολόκληρη τη λίστα, επομένως αυτό μεταφέρει ο αισθητήρας, μαζί με την εφαρμογή που τον έχει ορίσει.

english: The wind card is now a proper compass. A graduated dial with a marked ring, an eight-point rose and a two-tone needle, in place of the plain circle and line it had before.
translation: Η κάρτα wind είναι πλέον μια σωστή πυξίδα. Διαβαθμισμένο καντράν με σημαδεμένο δαχτυλίδι, τριαντάφυλλο οκτώ σημείων και δίχρωμη βελόνα, στη θέση του απλού κύκλου και γραμμής που είχε πριν.

english: Media players say what is playing, not just which app is open. An Android TV streaming a series now shows the programme, the season and episode, and the episode title, with the app named underneath; live TV shows the channel.
translation: Οι συσκευές αναπαραγωγής πολυμέσων λένε τι παίζει, όχι μόνο ποια εφαρμογή είναι ανοιχτή. Ένα Android TV με ροή μιας σειράς εμφανίζει τώρα το πρόγραμμα, τη σεζόν και το επεισόδιο, καθώς και τον τίτλο του επεισοδίου, με την εφαρμογή να ονομάζεται από κάτω. ζωντανή τηλεόραση δείχνει το κανάλι.

english: Backing out of a room now takes you to the room you were in before it, or to the room list — never to whichever tab you happened to open the room from.
translation: Το να βγείτε πίσω από ένα δωμάτιο σας μεταφέρει τώρα στο δωμάτιο στο οποίο ήσασταν πριν ή στη λίστα δωματίων — ποτέ σε οποιαδήποτε καρτέλα κι αν έτυχε να ανοίξετε το δωμάτιο.

english: Fixed temperature and energy readings in Czech, Slovak, Greek, Norwegian, Swedish and Danish. Machine translation had damaged the number formatting behind them, which showed the wrong number of decimals in the Nordic languages and could crash the screen in the other three.
translation: Σταθερές ενδείξεις θερμοκρασίας και ενέργειας στα Τσεχικά, Σλοβακικά, Ελληνικά, Νορβηγικά, Σουηδικά και Δανικά. Η μηχανική μετάφραση είχε καταστρέψει τη μορφοποίηση των αριθμών πίσω τους, η οποία έδειχνε λάθος αριθμό δεκαδικών ψηφίων στις σκανδιναβικές γλώσσες και θα μπορούσε να καταστρέψει την οθόνη στις άλλες τρεις.

english: Every language now has a single file anyone can correct. The translations folder in the repository holds one spreadsheet-friendly file per language, English beside the translation, so a native speaker can fix what reads wrong without touching any code.
translation: Κάθε γλώσσα έχει πλέον ένα μόνο αρχείο που μπορεί να διορθώσει ο καθένας. Ο φάκελος μεταφράσεων στο αποθετήριο περιέχει ένα αρχείο φιλικό προς το υπολογιστικό φύλλο ανά γλώσσα, τα Αγγλικά δίπλα στη μετάφραση, έτσι ώστε ένας μητρικός ομιλητής να μπορεί να διορθώσει αυτό που διαβάζεται λάθος χωρίς να αγγίξει κανέναν κώδικα.

english: Eighteen more languages, taking HKI 7 to 36. Polish, Russian, Czech, Slovak, Hungarian, Romanian, Bulgarian, Croatian, Greek, Lithuanian, Latvian, Estonian, Danish, Thai and Hebrew join the list, along with Austrian German, Swiss German and Mexican Spanish. Hebrew lays the interface out right to left, as Arabic does.
translation: Δεκαοκτώ ακόμη γλώσσες, φτάνοντας το HKI 7 στο 36. Πολωνικά, Ρωσικά, Τσέχικα, Σλοβακικά, Ουγγρικά, Ρουμανικά, Βουλγαρικά, Κροατικά, Ελληνικά, Λιθουανικά, Λετονικά, Εσθονικά, Δανικά, Ταϊλανδικά και Εβραϊκά προστίθενται στη λίστα, μαζί με τα Αυστριακά Γερμανικά, τα Ελβετικά Γερμανικά και τα Μεξικανικά Ισπανικά. Τα Εβραϊκά απλώνουν τη διεπαφή από δεξιά προς τα αριστερά, όπως τα αραβικά.

english: HKI 7 now runs on Android 12 and later. It previously needed Android 14, which ruled out a lot of perfectly capable phones and tablets.
translation: Το HKI 7 εκτελείται πλέον σε Android 12 και μεταγενέστερες εκδόσεις. Χρειαζόταν προηγουμένως το Android 14, το οποίο απέκλεισε πολλά τηλέφωνα και tablet με τέλεια ικανότητα.

english: Energy costs are shown in your own currency instead of always in euros. HKI 7 follows what your cost sensors report, and there is a Currency setting in Energy settings if you would rather choose one yourself.
translation: Το κόστος ενέργειας εμφανίζεται στο δικό σας νόμισμα αντί πάντα σε ευρώ. Το HKI 7 ακολουθεί αυτό που αναφέρουν οι αισθητήρες κόστους σας και υπάρχει μια ρύθμιση νομίσματος στις ρυθμίσεις ενέργειας, εάν προτιμάτε να επιλέξετε μία μόνοι σας.

english: The language picker has a search box and is sorted, which it needed at 36 entries. If you ever land in a language you cannot read, the way back is still the first thing on screen.
translation: Ο επιλογέας γλώσσας έχει ένα πλαίσιο αναζήτησης και είναι ταξινομημένο, το οποίο χρειαζόταν σε 36 καταχωρήσεις. Αν ποτέ προσγειωθείτε σε μια γλώσσα που δεν μπορείτε να διαβάσετε, ο δρόμος της επιστροφής εξακολουθεί να είναι το πρώτο πράγμα στην οθόνη.

english: Views remember where you had scrolled to, and tapping the tab you are already on takes you back to the top.
translation: Οι προβολές θυμούνται πού είχατε κύλιση και πατώντας την καρτέλα στην οποία βρίσκεστε ήδη, θα επιστρέψετε στην κορυφή.

english: Swiping sideways no longer carries you out of a page you have opened, such as Solar inside Energy. Back now returns you to the view you came from rather than jumping to the home page.
translation: Το σάρωση προς τα πλάγια δεν σας βγάζει πλέον από μια σελίδα που έχετε ανοίξει, όπως η Solar inside Energy. Το Back now σας επιστρέφει στην προβολή από την οποία προήλθατε αντί να μεταβείτε στην αρχική σελίδα.

english: Scrollable rows say so. The pull-down menu, the navigation bar and the settings tabs all show an arrow at the edge when there is more to reach.
translation: Οι σειρές με δυνατότητα κύλισης το λένε. Το αναπτυσσόμενο μενού, η γραμμή πλοήγησης και οι καρτέλες ρυθμίσεων δείχνουν όλα ένα βέλος στην άκρη όταν υπάρχουν περισσότερα για να φτάσετε.

english: Dialogs look and behave the same throughout. Six of them were plain Android dialogs with no close button in the corner, and buttons across the app now agree on what Close, Save and Done mean.
translation: Οι διάλογοι φαίνονται και συμπεριφέρονται το ίδιο παντού. Έξι από αυτά ήταν απλά παράθυρα διαλόγου Android χωρίς κουμπί κλεισίματος στη γωνία και τα κουμπιά σε όλη την εφαρμογή συμφωνούν πλέον για το τι σημαίνουν Κλείσιμο, Αποθήκευση και Τέλος.

english: Creating a dashboard asks first and then offers the same choices as first-time setup — so a new dashboard can start from a backup or from one your family has shared, as well as being generated or left empty. Your current dashboard is never overwritten, and shared dashboards are now marked as shared in the list.
translation: Η δημιουργία ενός πίνακα εργαλείων ζητά πρώτα και στη συνέχεια προσφέρει τις ίδιες επιλογές με τη ρύθμιση για πρώτη φορά — έτσι ένας νέος πίνακας εργαλείων μπορεί να ξεκινήσει από ένα αντίγραφο ασφαλείας ή από ένα που έχει μοιραστεί η οικογένειά σας, καθώς και να δημιουργηθεί ή να μείνει κενό. Ο τρέχων πίνακας εργαλείων σας δεν αντικαθίσταται ποτέ και οι κοινόχρηστοι πίνακες εργαλείων επισημαίνονται πλέον ως κοινόχρηστοι στη λίστα.

english: The battery widget opens a list in place instead of taking you to a separate page, grouped by how urgent each one is and showing the battery type where Home Assistant knows it. There is a search box, and a button to open the full Battery view if you want it.
translation: Το γραφικό στοιχείο μπαταρίας ανοίγει μια λίστα στη θέση του αντί να σας μεταφέρει σε μια ξεχωριστή σελίδα, ομαδοποιημένη ανάλογα με το πόσο επείγον είναι η καθεμία και εμφανίζει τον τύπο μπαταρίας όπου ο Home Assistant το γνωρίζει. Υπάρχει ένα πλαίσιο αναζήτησης και ένα κουμπί για να ανοίξετε την πλήρη προβολή μπαταρίας εάν το θέλετε.

english: Tapping the people counter in a room shows who is there, with each person's picture. The Rooms header now has a household counter too, showing where everyone is without opening every room.
translation: Πατώντας το μετρητή ατόμων σε ένα δωμάτιο δείχνει ποιος είναι εκεί, με τη φωτογραφία του καθενός. Η κεφαλίδα Δωμάτια έχει πλέον και έναν οικιακό μετρητή, που δείχνει πού βρίσκονται όλοι χωρίς να ανοίγει κάθε δωμάτιο.

english: A button can be left out of a room's Lights and Devices counters, for the ones that are in the room but not really part of it.
translation: Ένα κουμπί μπορεί να μείνει έξω από τους μετρητές Φώτων και Συσκευών ενός δωματίου, για αυτούς που βρίσκονται στο δωμάτιο αλλά δεν είναι πραγματικά μέρος του.

english: Widgets that need an integration you do not have — Formula 1, Parcels, Waste Collection — are greyed out and say what is missing, instead of being added and then sitting empty.
translation: Τα γραφικά στοιχεία που χρειάζονται μια ενσωμάτωση που δεν έχετε — Formula 1, Parcels, Waste Collection — είναι γκριζαρισμένα και λένε τι λείπει, αντί να προστεθούν και μετά να μείνουν άδεια.

english: Parcel tracking covers fifteen more carriers, including PostNord, InPost, Swiss Post, An Post, Budbee, Sameday and Nova Post, each with its own logo.
translation: Η παρακολούθηση δεμάτων καλύπτει δεκαπέντε ακόμη μεταφορείς, συμπεριλαμβανομένων των PostNord, InPost, Swiss Post, An Post, Budbee, Sameday και Nova Post, ο καθένας με το δικό του λογότυπο.

english: A Valetudo robot vacuum picks up its live map automatically when your rooms are imported, rather than needing the camera chosen by hand.
translation: Ένα Valetudo ρομπότ με ηλεκτρική σκούπα παίρνει αυτόματα τον ζωντανό χάρτη του όταν εισάγονται τα δωμάτιά σας, αντί να χρειάζεται την κάμερα που επιλέγεται με το χέρι.

english: Swiping between tabs now follows your finger. The pages move as you drag, you can change your mind mid-swipe and pull them back, and they settle where you let go. Previously the change was decided the moment you had dragged far enough and could not be taken back, while the animation that played afterwards was on its own timer and unrelated to the gesture — so the app committed to a page before your finger had finished asking for one.

The bottom bar now keeps the selected tab in view. On a phone too narrow for every tab it scrolls the active one to the centre, so the tab you are on is always visible along with its neighbours — which is also the hint that there are more pages to swipe to. Reaching the last tab used to leave the indicator somewhere off the end of the bar.

Swiping between rooms shows how many rooms there are and which one you are on, as dots above the navigation bar — or as a count once there are more than eight. Room swiping also stops at the last room instead of wrapping around to the first, matching how the tabs behave. Rooms an admin has hidden are now skipped by the swipe rather than only blocked when opened.

The pull-down header menu animates to wherever you let it go, instead of jumping open or shut in a single frame. It settles by which half you released it in, a quick flick opens it without a full-length drag, and it can be caught and dragged again mid-animation. It also no longer stops dead partway when pulled a long way but not quite far enough.

Settings remembers where you were. Coming back from a sub-menu returns to the place in the list you left rather than to the top, which was most noticeable on the long way down to About and Licenses. The page settings dialog had the opposite problem — one scroll position carried across unrelated sub-menus — and that is fixed too.

The notification panel now has a button in the pull-down header menu, so the left-edge swipe is no longer the only way to reach it. That let the strip of screen edge reserved for the swipe shrink from 200dp to 88dp: the reserved strip is where Android's own back gesture stops working, and it had been covering the exact corner where the back arrow sits.

Fixed the app closing instead of the notification panel when back was pressed during the panel's opening animation. Back is also defined for the tabs now — it returns to the first tab before leaving the app, rather than exiting from wherever you happened to have swiped to.
The home switcher panel follows Android's predictive back gesture, sliding out with your finger and springing back if you change your mind.

Four more languages: Norwegian, Swedish, Finnish and Arabic. Arabic lays the whole app out right to left — the navigation bar, the panels that slide in from the screen edge, and the swipe that moves between tabs all mirror, rather than only the text changing direction. Product names such as Home Assistant stay in Latin script wherever they appear.
notes: needs translation; don't translate Home Assistant

english: Swiping between rooms is much smoother. A room screen is by far the heaviest page in the app, and the next one was being built during the first frames of the swipe — precisely when there was no time for it. It is now prepared while nothing is moving, and live sensor updates wait for the swipe to finish instead of redrawing every open page mid-gesture.

The notification panel and the home switcher are dragged rather than flicked open, following your finger and settling where you let go. They close the same way: push them back towards the edge they came from. Tapping the panel itself no longer closes it, which it used to do anywhere you touched that was not a button.

A horizontal row inside a page — a mode selector, a swipe row, a swiping stack — no longer hands the rest of the gesture to the page once it reaches its end. Picking the first or last item in such a row used to flip the whole page instead.

Dialogs with tabs show how many there are and which one you are on, and a sideways swipe anywhere on the dialog changes tab. The swipe used to be written off as a scroll whenever it set off with the slight downward arc a thumb naturally makes, which made it feel like it worked only sometimes.

Demo mode no longer talks to the network. Twenty-six requests — the whole HKI 7 Cloud surface plus the event timeline, camera snapshots and vacuum maps — were still being attempted against a server that does not exist, and one of them retried every three seconds for the entire session, filling the connection log with failures. Restarting Home Assistant in the demo is now simulated in a few seconds rather than showing "restarting" for two minutes and giving up.
notes: needs translation; don't translate HKI 7 Cloud, Home Assistant

english: New Events tab in the notification drawer: a timeline of what your home has actually been doing. The front door opening, a light going off, someone arriving home — each with the time and, where Home Assistant knows, who did it. An admin picks which entities appear under Settings › Family Sharing › Events, once for the whole family rather than on every phone. It reads Home Assistant's own logbook rather than recording anything on the device, so it still shows what happened overnight while the app was closed, and it opens on the last 3 hours — a timeline answers what just happened — with 6h to 72h a tap away. Events never touch the notification bell's unread count: a timeline of doors opening would leave that badge permanently lit and mean nothing. Requires HKI 7 Cloud 0.9.0.*
notes: needs translation; don't translate HKI 7 Cloud, Home Assistant

english: An admin can take parts of the timeline away from individual family members — a whole domain, or named entities — from the same Events tab. Everyone sees the full timeline unless something is taken out for them, so adding a person to the family does not mean building their timeline from scratch. The filtering happens in the HKI 7 Cloud component rather than in the app, so a restricted device is never even told which entities it is being kept away from. As with hidden views and rooms, this hides the timeline rather than the entities: Home Assistant has no per-entity read permission for non-admin accounts, so anyone signed in can still read those entities through Home Assistant itself.*
notes: needs translation; don't translate HKI 7 Cloud, Home Assistant

english: The event roster takes whole domains as well as named entities, so "every lock" is one choice rather than eleven. Domains are resolved fresh each time the timeline opens, so a lock added next month joins on its own instead of the roster meaning whatever existed the day it was set. The editor shows what each domain currently covers, since one domain can be hundreds of entities. Requires HKI 7 Cloud 0.10.0.*
notes: needs translation; don't translate HKI 7 Cloud

english: Events are labelled and filterable by what kind of thing they happened to — Doors, Windows, Motion, Lights, Locks. The filter row is built from what your timeline actually contains, so you are never offered a filter that can only come back empty. Days stay as the list headings: a timeline that reorders itself by category stops being a timeline.
Weather artwork now animates in the daily forecast, the hourly strip and the header pill, not only on the hero card. Animation was previously switched off below a fixed size, which caught all three.

Where weather artwork animates is now four separate switches — header pill, weather dialog, forecast strips, weather widget — instead of riding on the entity icon animation setting. The forecast strips animate a dozen icons side by side and are the only ones that ever cost anything noticeable, so turning those off need not mean losing the single small icon in the header pill. All four are on by default, and appear both in Settings › Appearance › Icons and in the header pill's own settings.
The 6h/12h/24h/48h/72h range selector is centred rather than left-aligned everywhere it appears, and gains a 3h option.

New Connection log at the bottom of Settings › Connection: what the app's connection has actually been doing — connection attempts, reconnects, sync and subscriptions — with buttons to copy or clear it. All of this was already being recorded; nothing displayed it. It holds the last 300 lines and starts empty each launch.
A button stack's layout options are now named the same as a single button's. The same shape was called Tile on a button and Compact on a stack, which made them look like different features.

New Centered button layout beside Standard, Square and Tile: a square card whose icon sits in the middle of the space above the text, with the name and state centred beneath it. The icon is pushed upward rather than crowded as the text grows. A grid of these reads as a keypad, which is what makes a remote control possible.

A button's icon, name and state are each shown or hidden on their own, under a new Elements section in its settings. The old Icon only switch is gone — hiding both the name and state is what it did, and these also let you keep one of them. Existing icon-only buttons keep working.

A button stack carries the same three switches for all of its children, so a stack of twenty buttons need not be set twenty times. Turning one off on the stack hides it on every button; leaving it on lets each button decide.
Fixed the button stack settings dialog stopping about two thirds of the way down with empty space below it, leaving the rest unreachable on a tall phone or a tablet.

Navigation bar, media players and popups moved from Settings › Appearance to Settings › Dashboard, below the dashboards themselves. They are parts of what the dashboard is made of rather than how it is styled.
Settings › Connection ends with the connection log, and Restart Home Assistant now sits below it rather than above — it is the most disruptive thing on the screen and the least often wanted.
notes: needs translation; don't translate Home Assistant

english: The Events tab gives an admin a button straight to Settings › Family Sharing › Events when nothing is being tracked yet, instead of only naming where to go.

Entity and domain pickers list what is already selected first, so undoing a choice does not mean hunting for it alphabetically. The order is fixed when the picker opens, so ticking something does not make it jump away from your finger.

A button stack's heading now has explicit Show name and Show icon switches, plus an option to centre them. Clearing the text field used to be the only way to get a stack with no heading, which hid that it was possible and meant losing the name to hide it.

An admin can now change who a published family dashboard is shared with, instead of only being able to choose at the moment of publishing. Settings › Family Sharing › Dashboards lists who each published dashboard reaches, with a Manage access button to add or remove people. Until now the only way to take a dashboard away from one person was to delete it for everybody.*

Losing access to a family dashboard now clears what was layered on top of it. The dashboard itself was already removed, but the rooms, widgets, pages, nav bar, header pill and theme it left behind on the device stayed — so the next dashboard an admin shared arrived on top of the previous one's leftovers and looked like it had failed to import in full. Everything that belonged to the revoked dashboard is now removed with it. Home Assistant connections, profiles and notification settings are untouched: losing a dashboard is not being signed out.*
notes: needs translation; don't translate Home Assistant

english: New Devices tab under Settings › Family Sharing, showing which HKI version each family device is running and flagging the ones older than yours, with the Home Assistant account, device name, Android version and when it last reported. Each install records this through the HKI 7 Cloud component over the connection the app already uses, so every signed-in device is covered — including one with Location and Notifications both switched off — and nothing is added to Home Assistant's entity list. A device can only ever report itself. An admin can forget a phone that has been replaced; one still in use reappears the next time its app opens. Requires HKI 7 Cloud 0.7.0.*
notes: needs translation; don't translate HKI 7 Cloud, Home Assistant

english: An admin can now require the family to update. "Require everyone to be on this version" in the Devices tab sets a household minimum; anyone below it gets a full-screen prompt on their next launch instead of the dashboard, with Google Play's in-app update doing the install. There is also a per-device "Ask to update" for when one phone is behind rather than everyone, which clears itself once that device updates. No app can install a newer version of itself, so Play does the actual work — which also means the prompt can only insist when Play genuinely has the update ready. When it does not, the prompt explains why and lets you past for that session, rather than locking someone out of their own locks and alarms over an update they cannot get. You can only require a version some family device already runs. Requires HKI 7 Cloud 0.8.0.*
notes: needs translation; don't translate HKI 7 Cloud

english: Each Family Sharing tab now says for itself when it needs a newer HKI 7 Cloud than the one installed, instead of that only appearing in the summary at the top of the screen. Parental controls, Permissions, Presence and Devices each carry the version they need, so it is clear before you configure a tab whose settings the installed component cannot store yet.
notes: needs translation; don't translate HKI 7 Cloud

english: Fixed a crash that could take the whole app down during the very first connection attempt after opening it, which read as "the app won't even open". The setup that runs on every launch had no error handling of its own, so a failure there — usually an expired session being refreshed on a flaky network — escaped as an unhandled error instead of surfacing as a connection error you could retry. As a backstop, an unexpected error on a background task can no longer terminate the app at all.

The dashboard no longer rebuilds itself every time Home Assistant reports a state change. The home screen tracked the complete entity list, so a single motion sensor tripping or a power meter ticking — several times a second on a busy install — invalidated the whole screen and every widget on it, even when nothing visible had changed. It now watches only what it actually draws.
notes: needs translation; don't translate Home Assistant

english: Entity icon animations no longer redo layout work on every frame they animate. The spin, pulse and glow effects re-ran the surrounding widget's composition on each animation frame instead of just redrawing the icon, so any dashboard with an active light, an open door or a recording camera paid that cost continuously. The animations look exactly the same.

Fixed the app becoming unresponsive — and eventually killed by Android — when opening the history of a busy entity, such as a motion sensor that logs thousands of state changes a day. Matching each history entry to its actor re-scanned and re-parsed the entire logbook's timestamps from scratch for every single entry, work that scaled with history size squared; a quiet entity never noticed, but a busy one could peg the CPU for ten seconds straight. The logbook is now parsed once instead of once per entry, and the whole fetch runs off the main thread.

Hardened how the app reads attributes Home Assistant sends for an entity: a value present but shaped unexpectedly (an object or array where a plain number or piece of text was expected) used to throw and crash whatever screen read it, instead of just being treated as missing.
notes: needs translation; don't translate Home Assistant

english: Fixed "Push to family dashboard" reporting a dashboard as already up to date no matter what had changed. A dashboard re-imported after a reinstall is stored locally under a different id than the one the cloud copy is published under, and the push check was still looking up the local export by the cloud id, finding nothing, and silently skipping that dashboard on every push.

The Formula 1 widget gains two new tabs and expands two existing ones. Calendar lists the season's races in order, with each circuit and the host country's flag. Grid shows the starting grid, with each driver's move up or down from where they qualified. Standings can now show a championship prediction alongside the points table — current and predicted final points, for drivers or constructors — when F1 Sensor's optional F1TV Auth is set up. Live gains a proper timing list: gap to the leader, interval to the car ahead, tyre compound and stint length, and pit/retired status for every driver, plus which lap the leader is on.

Fixed shared family dashboards failing to update at all once the owner added a widget type introduced in a newer app version, such as the To-Do List or Formula 1 widgets. A single unrecognized widget used to fail the whole dashboard, so a family member on an older build stopped receiving any of that dashboard's changes instead of just missing the new widget. Unrecognized widgets are now skipped individually, so the rest of a shared dashboard keeps working across app versions.

The To-Do widget's square card can now feature one whole list instead of items individually flagged high priority. A new Hero list picker in the widget's General tab — shown once it has at least one tab — chooses which list's open items appear on the card, labelled with that list's name, so what you see at a glance is a specific list like Chores rather than a scattered mix pulled from every tab. Deleting a tab that's currently the hero list clears the setting automatically.

Fixed the app crashing whenever it needed to reconnect to Home Assistant or the connection failed. The in-app push-notification channel ran its subscription in a way that let a dropped connection's error skip past the surrounding error handling entirely and crash the app outright. A separate mismatch also meant every single reconnect immediately tore the whole sync stack down and rebuilt it a second time, racing its own freshly made connection. Both are fixed.
notes: needs translation; don't translate Home Assistant

english: Settings › Family Sharing now shows which HKI 7 Cloud version is installed, and — if it's behind — exactly which family features that leaves unavailable, each labelled with the version that unlocks it. Previously the only way to find out a component was out of date was to hit a save that silently dropped part of what you configured.*
notes: needs translation; don't translate HKI 7 Cloud

english: New To-Do List widget: a shared checklist or shopping list the whole family can add to. Items support an optional quantity, category, priority (low, normal or high, shown as a flag) and due date, with Added by and Checked by attribution when more than one person edits the list. Choose Manual, A–Z, Priority, or Newest-first ordering, and filter between To do, All, and Done from the dialog. Editing can be limited to everyone, specific family members picked from the real Home Assistant user list, or admins only, enforced the same way the rest of the app's family permissions are. It follows the same design as every other widget, with the usual General, Permissions, Appearance and Visibility settings tabs.
notes: needs translation; don't translate Home Assistant

english: Room following can now be set to only place someone in the right room when the app starts, without tracking them for the rest of the session. The existing Ask before switching rooms switch only chose between asking and switching silently; there was no way to get the one-time placement without the app continuing to follow every move afterward. A new Keep following while the app is open switch under each person's room-following settings turns that continued tracking off on its own, leaving Open their room when the app starts to do the one placement it always did.*

New Formula 1 widget, for the F1 Sensor integration. The card shows the next race with a countdown and the circuit outline; opening it gives four tabs — Next race with the full session schedule and trackside weather, Standings for drivers and constructors, Results for the last grand prix with places gained or lost, and a Live tab that appears only while a session is running, showing the flag and race control messages. It finds its sensors on its own: F1 Sensor lets you rename its entities and pick a language, so the widget matches on the integration's stable internal keys rather than entity ids.

New Find my devices widget: a map of your phones, watches, tags and trackers. Add any device_tracker or person entity; the ones reporting GPS appear as pins on the map, the rest are still listed with their state. Tick as many as you like to show them together, or leave nothing ticked to see everything. Three filters narrow the list: All, Devices, and People. The card follows the same design as the other widgets, so background image, icon, width, shape and corner radius all work as you would expect.

The maps in the app no longer look like a printed atlas. HKI now uses the same muted CARTO basemap that Home Assistant's own map card uses, instead of the standard OpenStreetMap rendering, which was designed as a mapper's reference render rather than a background for an app. It also has a proper dark variant, so the map finally follows your theme instead of glowing white inside a dark dialog.
notes: needs translation; don't translate Home Assistant

english: Fixed room following doing nothing at all once Ask before switching rooms was turned off. That switch was being treated as a master off-switch for the whole feature, so with prompting disabled the app neither asked nor moved. It now does what it says: with prompting on you get the prompt, with it off the room simply opens. Don't ask again until I restart still stops both, since trading a prompt for a surprise jump would be worse.

Fixed the waste widget's settings dialog being cut off around two thirds of the way down while empty space sat below it. The dialog reserves a tall card but its contents were capped at a fixed height, so the scroll area stopped short of the space available. Both the settings dialog and the waste dialog itself now use the full height.

The waste dialog's calendar can now look 7, 14 or 28 days ahead, and is drawn as a week grid like the calendar widget rather than a flat list: weekday columns, one row per week, and a coloured dot per collection in its fraction's colour. Tap a day to see what is collected then; it opens on the next day with a collection.
Parcel dialogs now say Today or Tomorrow instead of naming the weekday. The whole question a delivery date answers is how soon, and “Wednesday” on a Wednesday made you work that out yourself.

The +2 bubble in the header, shown when there are more people than fit, now opens. Tapping it lists everyone with their name and state, and picking someone opens their detail dialog as usual. Previously those people were simply unreachable on a narrow header.

Fixed the map in the person dialog overflowing the dialog on a tablet or unfolded foldable. The map was drawn as a square as wide as the dialog, so on a 620dp-wide card it became 620dp tall and pushed the address off the bottom. It now takes the height left over instead.

Fixed notifications going undelivered while Home Assistant reported the device as not connected to local push notifications, even with the app open. The app stood aside for its background connection whenever the settings said that connection should be running — but when Android refused to start it, such as after a reboot, nothing was listening at all. The app now checks whether that connection is really running rather than whether it is meant to be, takes over when it is not, and hands the channel back the moment it does come up.
notes: needs translation; don't translate Home Assistant

english: Fixed room-following settings not taking effect on the device you changed them from. Turning following off, or changing how long a room must hold before it counts as a move, was written to the companion component but not to the device's own cached copy — so it kept following, and kept using the old dwell time, until the app was next started. Changes now apply immediately. The dwell slider also no longer offers zero seconds, which made the very first sensor reading count as a move.

The Formula 1 card now says one thing: the next grand prix and when it is — “Today 15:00” on the day, otherwise the date and time, in your own timezone. Track status is gone from it, because outside a session that read “Not running”, which is not what anyone glances at the card for. The status sits in the same dark pill the camera, vacuum and waste cards use, so it lines up with the rest of your dashboard again. The circuit outline stays as a faint watermark and the host country flag in the corner. The widget also no longer asks which F1 instance to use — it reads everything the integration publishes, so the dialog always has the full picture.
The To-Do List dialog's undo/redo and Close buttons moved from the title row to the bottom action bar, matching every other dialog in the app.

english: HKI can now follow you from room to room. Point it at a room-presence sensor such as ESPresense and it opens the room you are in when the app starts, then offers to switch views when you move somewhere else. Rooms also gain a purple counter showing how many people are in them, beside the motion and presence counters. An admin sets this up for the whole family under Settings › Family Sharing › Presence: pick each person's sensor and how long a new room must hold before it counts as a move. Sensor rooms named after your Home Assistant areas are matched automatically.*

english: Notifications from Home Assistant can now carry action buttons. Add actions to a notify.mobile_app_… message and each one appears on the notification; tapping it sends the action back to Home Assistant, where an automation can respond. The buttons also appear on the in-app banner and in the notification drawer, because HKI hides system notifications while it is open. A URI action opens its link, a REPLY action takes a typed answer, and an action tapped while offline is delivered once the connection returns. Each notification can be actioned once.

english: New Action button: a button that needs no entity at all. Give it a name, an icon, and whatever tap, hold, or double-tap action you like — navigate to a view or room, call a Home Assistant action, open a URL or a custom popup. Add one from the widget picker, from a button stack, or as an action badge in the badge area beside the header.

english: Icon-only buttons can now be sized. Auto shrinks the icon as a stack gains columns, which is what makes icon-only usable in the four-, five-, and six-column custom popups where a fixed-size icon used to overflow the button. A button can also be given its own size.

Button stacks can push their appearance onto every button they hold: one Icon only for every button switch instead of the same switch on twenty buttons, plus an icon size they all inherit. A single button can still override the size.
The quick start guide can be browsed by hand. Swipe the gesture preview, tap a dot, or tap any tip to jump to it. It still plays on its own until you take over.

Fixed the waste widget showing the wrong icon and colour for every collection type outside Dutch: the type was matched against the translated label, so PMD shown as Packaging fell through to a generic grey-blue bin. PMD is orange with a recycling symbol again.

Fixed the room-following prompt appearing after Ask before switching rooms was turned off, and for the room already on screen. It now also offers Don't ask again until I restart the app, and the wait time can be set whether or not prompting is on.

Flows can express Any of these and nested logic, not just a flat list of ANDs. A group opens into its own list with a breadcrumb, and groups can hold groups, so motion detected AND (after sunset OR guest mode on) is buildable. It is the same structure Home Assistant's own editor writes, so a flow made in HA that used OR is no longer an untouchable advanced block.
notes: needs translation; don't translate Home Assistant

english: Thermostat dials on the Climate view no longer squeeze six across a landscape foldable. Dials hold at four per row until the window is genuinely desktop-wide, so each keeps enough width to read.

The Waiting for notifications message now has a Hide this notification button that jumps straight to its Android channel settings, where switching the channel off hides it for good while the connection keeps working. Android will not let a background connection run without a visible notification, so this is as far as muting can go. It also switches itself on when you have more than one Home Assistant server.

english: The vacuum widget can now draw a Valetudo map itself. Choose Valetudo map as the button image and point it at your robot's map camera: HKI reads the map data Valetudo hides inside that camera's PNG and draws the floor, walls, rooms, the robot, its dock and the path it has taken. No add-on, custom component or extra Home Assistant integration is involved, and the map refreshes on its own while the robot is cleaning.

english: Tap a room on the Valetudo map to send the robot to clean it. Rooms use the names you gave them in Valetudo. Cleaning a single room goes through Home Assistant's clean_area action, so first map the robot's segments to your areas in Home Assistant — until you do, the map says so instead of leaving the tap doing nothing.

english: The vacuum settings now warn that plain Map camera on a Valetudo map entity shows a blank tile. Valetudo deliberately does not render the map on the robot, so its PNG is only a container for the data — Valetudo map is the mode that shows something.

The vacuum dialog now shows a Valetudo map whenever the map camera you picked actually carries one, whatever the button image is set to — the button image only decides how the tile on the dashboard looks. Cameras that turn out not to be Valetudo maps still show their picture, and HKI stops re-checking once it knows.

The robot image now spins while the vacuum is cleaning or returning to its dock, using the same icon animation settings as the rest of the app. A button's own animation setting still overrides it, and Off keeps it still.

english: Button widgets and button stacks can now hold an empty, fully transparent button. It takes up a grid cell without drawing anything, so the buttons around it line up exactly where you want them.
Buttons can show just their icon. The new Icon only switch under a button's Appearance settings drops the name and state and centers a larger icon on the button.

New Custom popup action for buttons, badges, and dialog buttons. Point any tap, hold, or double tap at a popup you build yourself: it opens with the usual dialog title, status, history, and close controls, and you fill it with any widget the app offers. Popups are listed under Settings › Appearance › Popups, where Edit contents opens one ready to arrange. Popups are shared, so several buttons can open the same one, and stacks inside a popup can use up to six columns instead of three. While a popup is being arranged, a Done button sits beside Add widget to leave edit mode without closing it.

Fixed the Energy detail views (Solar, Electricity, Gas, Water, City heating, Battery) drawing their cards flush against each other with their headings missing. Production, Forecast, Inverters and the rest were hidden behind the card below them; the cards now keep their headings and the usual spacing.

Fixed Parental Controls refusing to save. An out-of-date HKI 7 Cloud component rejects the Visible and Invisible lists, which used to fail the whole policy; the permissions now save regardless and the message says the component needs updating. Those lists only filter entity lists such as global search — a button on a family dashboard stays visible unless it is hidden for that person explicitly.*

english: Rooms, Climate, Security, Energy, and Battery dashboards now make better use of tablets and foldables. Large cards follow the Home and individual-room 1/2/3-column layout, while compact tiles auto-fit without becoming cramped. Climate, Security, and Energy cards use a height-aware masonry layout on wider displays, eliminating large gaps below shorter cards.
State-colored icons on entity buttons and header/status pills now preserve their semantic hue while automatically shifting lighter or darker when they would blend into the current theme.

Selecting a family dashboard during onboarding now subscribes that installation to it. Owner edits are published when Save or Done is tapped, active clients refresh immediately, and offline clients reconcile when reopened. Non-admin subscribers cannot create or duplicate dashboards unless the app is fully reset.*

Dashboard setup during onboarding can now restore a local, Google Drive, or Home Assistant backup. New Google Drive and Home Assistant backups use consistent, informative names containing the app version and creation date.*

english: Calendar widgets become vertically scrollable when their height is too small for every event, and hidden Home widgets are removed from the layout instead of leaving an empty space.
Parcel carrier cards now show the earliest expected delivery date and time for active incoming or outgoing shipments, including integrations that expose a separate next-delivery sensor.

Family permissions can now independently allow dashboard switching and creation. Fully restricted subscribers see a locked Dashboard settings tab; onboarding removes its placeholder dashboard when switching is denied, and a deleted family dashboard opens a permission-aware recovery screen instead of silently creating a replacement.*

Family permissions now also control manual re-importing. Non-admins cannot open Family Sharing settings, disabled onboarding choices explain why they are unavailable, and aesthetics-only editors see only visual controls. Their local names, icons, colors, backgrounds, styles, sizes, and layouts take priority when owner updates arrive.*
Climate sensor/device tabs, Security groups, and every Energy detail tab now follow the same responsive one-, two-, or three-column masonry rules, including their edit and reorder layouts.
Aesthetics-only family editors can no longer change header-pill configuration or the dashboard's people; those functional settings remain controlled by the owner.*

Parental Controls now replaces manual entity-ID entry with Visible and Invisible lists. Admins can select complete Home Assistant domains or individual entities, and global search hides restricted entities and devices. Invisible entries always take precedence.*

Tariff 1 and tariff 2 readings are recognised separately, and usage charts and period totals add both tariffs together when no single grid import or export sensor is set.

Admins using a family-shared dashboard can choose whether an item is Visible or Hidden for a selected user. Person conditions use HKI 7 Cloud, whose requirement is shown when it is unavailable. New rules start empty so you choose Time, Entity, or Person.

english: Room-status counter badges keep a stable two-digit width. Headers responsively fit one, two, or three counters per row like the home-page and person badges, without pushing the title down.

Energy setup now recognises SmartGateways and DSMR Reader MQTT sensor names, and choosing a source device refills its separate sensor roles. City heating has dedicated settings, a source tile and detail tab, plus an estimated natural-gas equivalent for J/GJ heat readings.
Calendar widget dialogs now use the available height correctly, fixing content that previously occupied only half the settings dialog or was cut off.

Re-import settings now use one consistently spelled and localized label across Rooms, Climate, Security, Energy, and Battery. Conditional visibility wording was also corrected in every supported language.
Fixed PostNL and the current parcel-integration parser, so incoming shipments once again show their complete tracking details and delivered state. Carrier support has also been brought up to date.

Added an in-app language selector with full coverage in 13 languages: Dutch, German, French, Spanish (plus Latin American Spanish), Italian, Turkish, Portuguese (plus Brazilian Portuguese), Japanese, Korean, and Chinese (Simplified and Traditional). Each language shows its native name with an English hint beneath it.
The reconnect status now shows the actual connection error, making Wi-Fi, mobile-data, and VPN handovers much easier to diagnose.
Screen rotation now follows your device’s auto-rotate setting instead of staying locked to portrait.

The Climate "Outside" tile now appears as soon as a weather device is linked, even without dedicated sensors, counts its temperature, humidity and pressure attributes in the summary, and graphs them with matching sensor colors.

Parcel status codes are now normal sentences. Dates and times follow the selected language and 12/24-hour preference, nearby deliveries use weekday names, the current year is omitted, and same-day windows no longer repeat the date.
Drag to reorder cameras, thermostats, and energy cards. In edit mode the Security, Climate, and Energy views each get a Reorder button for their relevant cards.
New Climate Outside tile. Link a weather entity or outdoor temperature, humidity, and air-pressure sensors, then open the tile for individual history graphs.
Visibility now belongs to each button and header badge. Hide an item or schedule it once or on a daily, weekly, monthly, or yearly recurrence.
Header badges can be renamed from Appearance settings.
Swiping cards autoplay every three seconds by default.
The Weather dialog adds autoplay for Season, a windrose card, and an optional rain-map card from a camera or embedded web page.
The Parcels widget was rebuilt around carriers, with logos, account totals, shipment sections, estimates, tracking history, and add-by-tracking support where available.
Humidifiers and dehumidifiers now have native power, humidity, mode, speed, and helper controls throughout the app.
Room status counters are interactive and open the entities behind each count.
Buttons and badges can show a live countdown from a completion-time entity.
Shared dashboards publish owner edits automatically and recipients receive them on their next sync.
Header display settings now belong to each dashboard and travel through backups and family sharing.
Camera widgets fill the entire tile and follow the configured corner radius.
Waste collections on the same day now overlap visibly, and the larger dialog can be dismissed by tapping outside.
Battery, Waste, camera, weather, and About visuals are now more consistent.
Binary sensors use Home Assistant-style Open/Closed, Wet/Dry, Detected/Clear, and Connected/Disconnected labels.

english: This removes all imported rooms and floors from this view.
translation: Αυτό αφαιρεί όλα τα εισαγόμενα δωμάτια και πατώματα από αυτήν την προβολή.

translation: Αυτό καταργεί όλες τις εισαγόμενες οντότητες ασφαλείας από αυτήν την προβολή.

Η κατάργηση ιδιωτικών διευθύνσεων URL, διακριτικών, ονομάτων και δεδομένων τοποθεσίας συμβάλλει πρώτα στη διατήρηση της ασφάλειας της υποστήριξης.

english: When the value is a completion time (e.g. a washer/dryer finish time), show a descending timer. The button reads active while counting and turns off at zero.
translation: Όταν η τιμή είναι χρόνος ολοκλήρωσης (π.χ. χρόνος τελειώματος πλυντηρίου/στεγνωτηρίου), εμφανίστε ένα φθίνον χρονόμετρο. Το κουμπί διαβάζεται ενεργό κατά την καταμέτρηση και απενεργοποιείται στο μηδέν.

translation: Τα αναδυόμενα παράθυρα είναι κοινόχρηστα: άλλα κουμπιά μπορούν να ανοίξουν το ίδιο αναδυόμενο παράθυρο.

translation: Αυτό το αναδυόμενο παράθυρο είναι κενό. Πατήστε Επεξεργασία για να προσθέσετε γραφικά στοιχεία.

english: Build and edit your custom popups
translation: Δημιουργήστε και επεξεργαστείτε τα προσαρμοσμένα αναδυόμενα παράθυρά σας

translation: Τα αναδυόμενα παράθυρα ανοίγουν από ένα κουμπί, ένα σήμα ή ένα κουμπί διαλόγου που έχει οριστεί στην ενέργεια Προσαρμοσμένο αναδυόμενο παράθυρο. Η επεξεργασία περιεχομένου ανοίγει το ίδιο το αναδυόμενο παράθυρο, ώστε να μπορείτε να τακτοποιήσετε τα γραφικά στοιχεία του.

english: Auto shrinks the icon as the stack gains columns, so it still fits a narrow button.
translation: Αυτόματα συρρικνώνεται το εικονίδιο καθώς η στοίβα κερδίζει στήλες, επομένως εξακολουθεί να χωράει ένα στενό κουμπί.

translation: Δεν έχετε πλέον πρόσβαση στο HKI 7 μέσω αυτού του οικογενειακού πίνακα ελέγχου. Επιλέξτε έναν άλλο κοινόχρηστο πίνακα ελέγχου με εσάς ή χρησιμοποιήστε οποιαδήποτε άλλη επιλογή επιτρέπουν τα οικογενειακά σας δικαιώματα.

translation: Προσθήκη ή αφαίρεση ατόμων. Όλοι όσοι αφαιρείτε χάνουν αυτόν τον πίνακα ελέγχου την επόμενη φορά που θα συγχρονιστεί η εφαρμογή τους.

english: Losing access deletes their copy of this dashboard, along with any colours, icons, and names they changed on it.
translation: Η απώλεια πρόσβασης διαγράφει το αντίγραφο αυτού του πίνακα ελέγχου, μαζί με τυχόν χρώματα, εικονίδια και ονόματα που άλλαξαν σε αυτόν.

english: Which HKI build each family device is running. This device is on %1$s. A device appears once it has opened HKI 7 1.0.0-beta.18 or newer at least once.
translation: Ποια κατασκευή HKI εκτελεί κάθε οικογενειακή συσκευή. Αυτή η συσκευή βρίσκεται στο %1$s. Μια συσκευή εμφανίζεται μόλις ανοίξει την HKI 7 1.0.0-beta.18 ή νεότερη τουλάχιστον μία φορά.

Τίποτα εδώ δεν εγκαθιστά τίποτα — το Google Play κάνει την ενημέρωση, έτσι ώστε οι χρήστες να μένουν ανυπόμονοι μόνο όταν το Play το έχει πραγματικά έτοιμο για αυτούς.
Απαιτείται από όλους να είναι στο %1$s

translation: Αυτό το γραφικό στοιχείο χρησιμοποιεί τον επόμενο αγώνα, το ημερολόγιο σεζόν, το αρχικό πλέγμα, τις κατατάξεις οδηγών και κατασκευαστών, τα αποτελέσματα του τελευταίου αγώνα, τον καιρό και — κατά τη διάρκεια μιας συνεδρίας — την κατάσταση πίστας, την κατάσταση συνεδρίας, τον έλεγχο αγώνα, τις θέσεις των οδηγών και τα τρέχοντα ελαστικά. Εμφανίζει επίσης μια πρόβλεψη πρωταθλήματος όταν έχει ρυθμιστεί το προαιρετικό F1TV Auth του αισθητήρα F1. Δεν χρειάζονται άλλες επιλογές αισθητήρα F1 για αυτό.
Δεν υπάρχουν ακόμη διαθέσιμα αποτελέσματα αγώνα

english: The F1 Sensor integration was not found. Install it in Home Assistant (HACS: Nicxe/f1_sensor) and its sensors are picked up automatically.
translation: Η ενσωμάτωση του αισθητήρα F1 δεν βρέθηκε. Εγκαταστήστε το στο Home Assistant (HACS: Nicxe/f1_sensor) και οι αισθητήρες του συλλέγονται αυτόματα.

english: With no background image the card shows the upcoming race, with the circuit outline as a faint watermark behind it.
translation: Χωρίς εικόνα φόντου, η κάρτα δείχνει τον επερχόμενο αγώνα, με το περίγραμμα της πίστας ως ένα αμυδρό υδατογράφημα πίσω από αυτό.

english: A shared checklist your family can add to and check off
translation: Μια κοινόχρηστη λίστα ελέγχου στην οποία μπορεί να προσθέσει και να ελέγξει η οικογένειά σας

english: You don't have permission to edit this list.
translation: Δεν έχετε άδεια να επεξεργαστείτε αυτήν τη λίστα.

english: Show this list's open items on the square card.
translation: Εμφάνιση των ανοιχτών στοιχείων αυτής της λίστας στην τετράγωνη κάρτα.

english: Choose who can add, check off, or remove items
translation: Επιλέξτε ποιος μπορεί να προσθέσει, να ελέγξει ή να αφαιρέσει στοιχεία

english: Only an admin can choose specific members
translation: Μόνο ένας διαχειριστής μπορεί να επιλέξει συγκεκριμένα μέλη

english: Shared checklist or shopping list, editable by everyone, chosen members, or admins only
translation: Κοινόχρηστη λίστα ελέγχου ή λίστα αγορών, επεξεργάσιμη από όλους, επιλεγμένα μέλη ή μόνο διαχειριστές

english: Trackers to show on the map
Any device_tracker or person entity can be added. Those reporting GPS coordinates appear on the map; the rest are still listed with their state.
translation: Μπορεί να προστεθεί οποιοδήποτε device_tracker ή οντότητα προσώπου. Αυτές οι συντεταγμένες GPS που αναφέρουν εμφανίζονται στον χάρτη. οι υπόλοιποι εξακολουθούν να αναφέρονται με την κατάστασή τους.

english: Nothing of this kind in this widget
translation: Τίποτα αυτού του είδους σε αυτό το γραφικό στοιχείο

english: None of these devices report a location yet
translation: Καμία από αυτές τις συσκευές δεν αναφέρει ακόμη τοποθεσία

english: Map of your phones, tags, and trackers
translation: Χάρτης των τηλεφώνων, των ετικετών και των ιχνηλατών σας

english: How far ahead the dialog's calendar looks. It is shown as a week grid, rounded out to whole weeks.
translation: Πόσο μπροστά φαίνεται το ημερολόγιο του διαλόγου. Εμφανίζεται ως πλέγμα εβδομάδας, στρογγυλεμένο σε ολόκληρες εβδομάδες.

english: This battery view is empty. Swipe down on the header and open Battery settings to add entities manually.
translation: Αυτή η προβολή μπαταρίας είναι άδεια. Σύρετε προς τα κάτω στην κεφαλίδα και ανοίξτε τις Ρυθμίσεις μπαταρίας για να προσθέσετε οντότητες με μη αυτόματο τρόπο.

english: An analog or digital clock, in the style you pick, with the date and your next alarm.
translation: Ένα αναλογικό ή ψηφιακό ρολόι, στο στυλ που επιλέγετε, με την ημερομηνία και το επόμενο ξυπνητήρι σας.

english: Face, styling and what it shows
Analog or digital, and which design
translation: Αναλογικό ή ψηφιακό, και ποιο σχέδιο

translation: Επιλέξτε αυτό που εμφανίζεται παράλληλα με την ώρα

translation: Το Android ενημερώνει μόνο άλλες εφαρμογές για το επόμενο ξυπνητήρι, επομένως οι συναγερμοί δεν μπορούν να παρατίθενται ή να ενεργοποιούνται και να απενεργοποιούνται από εδώ.

english: No clock app could be opened. Pick one in this widget's settings.
translation: Δεν μπόρεσε να ανοίξει καμία εφαρμογή ρολογιού. Επιλέξτε ένα στις ρυθμίσεις αυτού του γραφικού στοιχείου.

translation: Ποια εφαρμογή ανοίγει το παράθυρο διαλόγου συναγερμού

translation: Δεν βρέθηκε εφαρμογή ρολογιού σε αυτήν τη συσκευή.
